channel.desc: About the Program SCALING UP TECH STARTUPS Innovative startups for future growth Targeting the global market with innovative technologies Small, but competitive businesses in Korea The revenues of small businesses have dropped due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and it is time to prepare proper measures to support small businesses. K-BIZ SEASON3 introduces small, but competitive businesses which have spearheaded effort to stabilize their businesses in the domestic market and achieve growth into global businesses. We introduce innovative items that have been developed based on the advanced technical capabilities as well as their production sites. We explore the growth of small companies, which aim to grow into mid-sized businesses and eventually emerge as global hidden champions. #K_BIZ #SEASON3 #SCALING_UP_TECH_STARTUPS #Korea_Institute_of_Startup_and_Entrepreneurship_Development #startup #global_business #technical_capabilities #competitiveness #Peter_Bint #Kim_Yun_jin #review #creativity.
